title: Past perfect
note: REWRITE 2026-08-05 · workable unit: earlier past vs past simple. Decision bank (not had/past participle form drills). Old 72-item form bank archived in git history pre this commit. Match idea/timeline → Quiz tense chips → Type full form → Use full sentence. · RUE2 TRANSPLANT 2026-08-25: blocks+intro restored from rue2-grok-v1.0 (James-smoked, quality=workable_draft); auto-authored bank superseded.

match_pairs: I lose keys · then I tell you
rain all night · then morning come
I go to Prague yesterday (one past time)

items.en: When I arrived, she had left.
items.cz: Když jsem přijel, už odešla.
items.gap: When I arrived, she ____.
accepts: When I arrived, she had left.
items.explanation: Leave is earlier than arrive → past perfect: had left.
items.explanation_cz: Odejít dřív než přijet → had left.

items.en: They had finished before we started.
items.cz: Dokončili to, než jsme začali.
items.gap: They ____ before we started.
accepts: They had finished before we started.
items.explanation: Finish is earlier than start → had finished.
items.explanation_cz: Dokončit dřív než začít → had finished.

items.en: After she had eaten, she went out.
items.cz: Až snědla, šla ven.
items.gap: After she ____, she went out.
accepts: After she had eaten, she went out.
items.explanation: Eat is earlier than go out → had eaten.
items.explanation_cz: Jíst dřív než jít ven → had eaten.

items.en: By the time we got there, the film had started.
items.cz: Než jsme tam dorazili, film už začal.
items.gap: By the time we got there, the film ____.
accepts: By the time we got there, the film had started.
items.explanation: Start is earlier than get there → had started.
items.explanation_cz: Začátek dřív než příchod → had started.

items.en: I called him, but he had already left.
items.cz: Volal jsem mu, ale už odešel.
items.gap: I called him, but he ____.
accepts: I called him, but he had already left.
items.explanation: Leave is earlier than call → had already left.
items.explanation_cz: Odejít dřív než volat → had already left.

items.en: She was tired because she had worked all day.
items.cz: Byla unavená, protože celý den pracovala.
items.gap: She was tired because she ____ all day.
accepts: She was tired because she had worked all day.
items.explanation: Work is earlier and explains was tired → had worked.
items.explanation_cz: Práce dřív a vysvětluje únavu → had worked.

items.en: When we opened the door, someone had broken the window.
items.cz: Když jsme otevřeli dveře, někdo rozbil okno.
items.gap: When we opened the door, someone ____ the window.
accepts: When we opened the door, someone had broken the window.
items.explanation: Break is earlier than open → had broken.
items.explanation_cz: Rozbít dřív než otevřít → had broken.

items.en: He couldn't get in because he had forgotten his keys.
items.cz: Nemohl se dostat dovnitř, protože zapomněl klíče.
items.gap: He couldn't get in because he ____ his keys.
accepts: He couldn't get in because he had forgotten his keys.
items.explanation: Forget is earlier than couldn't get in → had forgotten.
items.explanation_cz: Zapomenout dřív → had forgotten.

items.en: I knew the city well. I had lived there for five years.
items.cz: Znal jsem to město dobře. Bydlel jsem tam pět let.
items.gap: I knew the city well. I ____ there for five years.
accepts: I knew the city well. I had lived there for five years.
items.explanation: Live is earlier background before knew → had lived.
items.explanation_cz: Bydlení dřív (pozadí) → had lived.

items.en: The train had left when we reached the station.
items.cz: Vlak už odjel, když jsme dorazili na nádraží.
items.gap: The train ____ when we reached the station.
accepts: The train had left when we reached the station.
items.explanation: Train leave is earlier than we reach → had left.
items.explanation_cz: Odjezd dřív než příchod → had left.

items.en: I didn't recognise her. She had changed a lot.
items.cz: Nepoznal jsem ji. Hodně se změnila.
items.gap: I didn't recognise her. She ____ a lot.
accepts: I didn't recognise her. She had changed a lot.
items.explanation: Change is earlier than didn't recognise → had changed.
items.explanation_cz: Změna dřív → had changed.

items.en: We had never met before that day.
items.cz: Předtím jsme se nikdy nepotkali.
items.gap: We ____ before that day.
accepts: We had never met before that day.
items.explanation: No meeting in the time before that day → had never met.
items.explanation_cz: Až do toho dne se nepotkali → had never met.

items.en: After they had packed, they called a taxi.
items.cz: Až si sbalili, zavolali taxi.
items.gap: After they ____, they called a taxi.
accepts: After they had packed, they called a taxi.
items.explanation: Pack is earlier than call → had packed.
items.explanation_cz: Balení dřív než volat → had packed.

items.en: The shop had closed by six o'clock.
items.cz: Obchod už v šest byl zavřený.
items.gap: The shop ____ by six o'clock.
accepts: The shop had closed by six o'clock.
items.explanation: Closed earlier, before the point six o'clock → had closed.
items.explanation_cz: Zavřeno dřív než v šest → had closed.

items.en: I was happy because I had passed the exam.
items.cz: Byl jsem šťastný, protože jsem prošel u zkoušky.
items.gap: I was happy because I ____ the exam.
accepts: I was happy because I had passed the exam.
items.explanation: Pass is earlier and explains was happy → had passed.
items.explanation_cz: Úspěch dřív a vysvětluje radost → had passed.

items.en: When the police arrived, the thieves had gone.
items.cz: Když přijela policie, zloději už byli pryč.
items.gap: When the police arrived, the thieves ____.
accepts: When the police arrived, the thieves had gone.
items.explanation: Thieves leave earlier than police arrive → had gone.
items.explanation_cz: Odchod dřív než příjezd policie → had gone.

items.en: She showed me the book she had bought.
items.cz: Ukázala mi knihu, kterou koupila.
items.gap: She showed me the book she ____.
accepts: She showed me the book she had bought.
items.explanation: Buy is earlier than show → had bought.
items.explanation_cz: Koupit dřív než ukázat → had bought.

items.en: We stayed home because it had rained all morning.
items.cz: Zůstali jsme doma, protože celé ráno pršelo.
items.gap: We stayed home because it ____ all morning.
accepts: We stayed home because it had rained all morning.
items.explanation: Rain is earlier reason for stayed → had rained.
items.explanation_cz: Déšť dřív (důvod) → had rained.

items.en: I went to Prague yesterday.
items.cz: Včera jsem jel do Prahy.
items.gap: I ____ to Prague yesterday.
accepts: I went to Prague yesterday.
items.explanation: One finished past time (yesterday) → past simple, not past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Jeden hotový čas (yesterday) → past simple, ne past perfect.

items.en: We met in 2019.
items.cz: Seznámili jsme se v roce 2019.
accepts: We met in 2019.
items.explanation: Finished year → past simple. No second earlier event needed.
items.explanation_cz: Hotový rok → past simple. Není druhé dřívější dějství.

items.en: She called me last night.
items.cz: Včera v noci mi volala.
items.gap: She ____ me last night.
accepts: She called me last night.
items.explanation: Last night = finished past → past simple, not had called.
items.explanation_cz: Last night = hotová minulost → past simple.

items.en: I saw that film two years ago.
items.cz: Ten film jsem viděl před dvěma lety.
items.gap: I ____ that film two years ago.
accepts: I saw that film two years ago.
items.explanation: Ago = finished past → past simple, not past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Ago = hotová minulost → past simple.

items.en: They bought a house last summer.
items.cz: Minulé léto koupili dům.
items.gap: They ____ a house last summer.
accepts: They bought a house last summer.
items.explanation: Last summer → past simple. Don't use past perfect for every past fact.
items.explanation_cz: Last summer → past simple. Ne past perfect na každou minulost.

items.en: He finished school in June.
items.cz: V červnu dokončil školu.
items.gap: He ____ school in June.
accepts: He finished school in June.
items.explanation: In June (finished time) → past simple, not had finished.
items.explanation_cz: In June → past simple, ne had finished.

items.en: When I arrived, the lesson had already begun.
items.cz: Když jsem přišel, hodina už začala.
items.gap: When I arrived, the lesson ____.
accepts: When I arrived, the lesson had already begun.
When I arrived, the lesson had already started.
items.explanation: Begin is earlier than arrive → had already begun.
items.explanation_cz: Začátek dřív než příchod → had already begun.

items.en: I found the bag I had lost.
items.cz: Našel jsem tašku, kterou jsem ztratil.
items.gap: I found the bag I ____.
accepts: I found the bag I had lost.
items.explanation: Lose is earlier than find → had lost.
items.explanation_cz: Ztráta dřív než nalezení → had lost.

cards.title: What it is
cards.body: Past perfect is the **earlier** past — when one past event happens **before** another past event.
points: The **first** in time → past perfect (**had** + past participle)

cards.title: Timeline
cards.body: Think left → right on a past line. Past perfect sits on the **left** (earlier).
points: When I arrived, she had left.

cards.title: Form (short)
points: **had** + past participle: had left, had eaten, had finished

cards.title: Signals
points: **when / after / before / by the time** + two past events
**already / never / just** often with the earlier event
because + earlier reason in the past

rows: By the time we got there, it **had started**.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: **Miss past perfect** when something is clearly earlier
**Don't use past perfect** for every past fact — one finished time (yesterday, last year, ago) → past simple

cards.title: Quick check
points: I ____ to Prague yesterday. → **went** (not had gone)
